title: Character model
description: A models/<name>.yaml document of the game pack: which model a character draws and which of its clips each animation the engine asks for is. packages/engine/assets/src/character_model.cpp applies the same rules.

model.description: The asset id of the model (a binary glTF), such as digimon/species_a/model.

animations.description: Animation names the engine asks for (idle, walk, run...) and the clip each one plays: the original's animation id, which the extracted model keeps as its clip's extras.id and name anim_NN.
